name: CustomerLead — copy event adapters into your existing workflow

parameters.content:
# Copy these adapters into the original workflow
Each pair is a Code adapter + authenticated HTTP event publisher. Source node names are matched to your supplied export. Follow the connection guide for exact attachment points.

The shared URL uses Docker Desktop host.docker.internal:3001. Select the CustomerLead Header Auth credential on every HTTP node. No Gmail, Sheets, or AI credential is included. These adapters publish saved outcomes and never send customer email.

nodes.name: Publish Form captured
nodes.notes: Select the CustomerLead HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <private token>. No token is included in this file.
